steps.text: Searching for gray Teslas, 2023 or newer, with black interior…

I found 131 gray Teslas with a black interior, model year 2023 or newer, and under 42,100 miles. I only looked at the first page of 24. The 8 cards are the lowest-priced cars from that page, ordered cheapest first. They include Model 3 and Model Y cars. I haven't checked delivery dates. I can check those, look at the other pages, or narrow the list by model, year or budget.
